The so-called '''"Dark Worlds"''' was an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] principality, located at the furthest reaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which the genetic terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]] had claimed as his personal kingdom. Magnus carved out his kingdom using the followers and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] he had gathered during his journey around the galaxy. It was composed of a group of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] ruled by Magnus, who considered the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]], the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]], an [[Ebruchi]] [[Unidentified Ebruchi clan|clan]], and the [[Rhandites|Rhandite nihilists]] as his neighbours. The terrorist's seat of power was the [[Rennek palace]], deep within the "Dark Worlds." At some point in time before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Rhandite nihilists would "bless" these worlds.<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Atha Prime, genetics master, ruler of the dark worlds [...]|''Kenner'' 1985-86 Line Extension Presentation Binder|<ref name="apd">{{WebCite|url=http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=50966|text=1985-86 Line Extension Presentation Binder Page 9 - Atha Prime Description|work=The Star Wars Collectors Archive|archivedate=20210214104336}}</ref>}}
Reference to "dark worlds", lower-case, first appeared in [[Kenner Products|Kenner]]'s aborted [[1986]] "''[[The Epic Continues]]''" product line<ref name="apd" /> but the worlds were not canonized until the release of ''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]'' in [[2015]] in which they were capitalized as "Dark Worlds".<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />
